title: Value
description: An epistemically-tagged value. A Value of kind FACT or RESULT with empty support[] is INVALID.

content.description: The asserted content. Absent -> use UNKNOWN; disputed -> UNCERTAIN; conflicting -> CONTRADICTED.

support.description: Ids of the objects (SRC/EXP/RES/...) that back this value. FACT/RESULT require >=1.
